name: mercurians_horseman
description: a Mercurian Horseman, an angelic rider with a golden halo over a silver helmet, long golden hair and white feathered wings on his back, in silver armour over a blue tabard with gold trim, a steel-tipped spear with a gold-banded wooden shaft held upright in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side and a round blue shield with a gold rim and a gold boss on his RIGHT arm on the screen-left side, riding a white horse with a grey mane and tail, a blue-and-gold bridle, a blue saddle cloth and brown hooves
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round blue shield on his right arm on the screen-left side; his white wings stay folded on his back
